chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: The All Star Orchestra, Benny Goodman and Glenn Miller
summary: Kline lists the 1927-28 All Star Orchestra sessions and asks about playing with the young Benny Goodman, whom Morehouse says played pretty well.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Del Stiegers played trumpet I guess. /Sp? Right?
With the All Star orchestra, with Miff Moll and Dudley Fosdick, Fud Livingston, Don Murray, Joe Venuti. He made some records back in '27. Chloe and 'Alexander's Ragtime Band.'
Do you remember the All Star Orchestra, anything about them, who they were? How they got together?
No, okay. They kept changing people, I mean adding people. Before you mentioned, you showed me a picture of Joe Tarto. Do you remember?
He was one of the members of this group too.
Glenn Miller, do you remember playing with them?
Do you remember anything about Benny Goodman and Jimmy McPartland. Benny Goodman?
Do you remember playing with him?
What did you think of him then, 1928? He was very young. Of course you were very young. Do you have any memories of how well he played in those days?
How well he played, how well Benny Goodman played in those days.
Do you remember? Were you impressed?
